project_title: Machine Learning Enhanced Graph-Based Anomaly Detection for Financial Transactions

matching.count_and_evidence_fraction: exact; same account and historical incident denominator
matching.selection: Enumerate all count-matched subsets under the bound; filter all budgets and both monetary calipers; order by SHA256(seed, context, structured identity, control IDs); select first two distinct sets
matching.insufficient_controls: unmatched; no tolerance relaxation or single-control substitution
matching.context: Identical history hash, cutoff, time kind, population, account, model and canonical19 schema

cohort: All six Phase5G accounts, unchanged; no labels or outcome selection

methods.D: Maximum count among same eligible pool
methods.E: Two distinct strict matched random omissions separately per available A-D anchor
methods.ties: Ascending family, string candidate key, sorted IDs
methods.B: First lexicographically eligible whole temporal block
methods.A: First lexicographically eligible whole counterparty group
methods.C: Maximum Decimal amount among all eligible whole counterparty and temporal groups

scope: One explanation per method/account; common original cutoff, count<=2, count fraction<=0.5, amount fraction<=0.5, retain>=1. No ranking or labels
stability: Fixed selection/matching replay; uncached reference/replay first account per score stratum; reverse all event rows; independently increase one hash-selected incident amount by 1% for each of the same three representatives, in memory only
feasibility: First new scenario plus full-reference and replay; project remaining unique work with 2x measured allowance. Stop incomplete if above remaining 1800s; never shrink cohort
projection: Same 5K graph and eligible mix; cold unique scenarios, measured versus projected kept distinct
